description:
Yeonhwa has been plagued by vivid, unsettling dreams every night for over two weeks—dreams so real they leave her dazed, as if intoxicated. The figure in her dreams is inhuman, serpent-like, and terrifyingly intimate. One night, a shadow appears beyond her door, blurring the line between dream and reality.

When a mysterious man enters, revealing the form of a giant white serpent, Yeonhwa realizes the nightmare may have followed her into the waking world—bringing with it a chilling threat and an inescapable fate.

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13669373)
